segments.t: At a VIP table in the Claude Monet dining room, wealthy guests taste the newly served black caviar delicacy. Completely oblivious to the kitchen's culinary disguise, the diners rave about its fresh natural Astrakhan quality. Listen to their conversation in Russian first, then we will break down each line in English.
Да, я такую только в Астрахани ел.
В Москве редко встретишь такое качество.
Я готов приходить сюда каждый день.
Now let's go back through the exchange around Astrakhan Caviar line by line and unpack how the Russian works.
'Taste this appetizer, gentlemen.' At the VIP table in the dining room, the host invites his companions to try the caviar appetizer.
'Listen, this is wonderful caviar!' Taking a bite, the second guest marvels at how wonderful the caviar is.
'You can immediately sense that it is natural.' The first guest nods sagely, claiming you can tell right away that it is all-natural.
Да, я такую только в Астрахани ел.
'Yes, I only ever ate such caviar in Astrakhan.' His friend agrees, saying he has only tasted caviar this good in Astrakhan.
В Москве редко встретишь такое качество.
'In Moscow you rarely encounter such quality.' The host remarks that finding such genuine quality in Moscow is rare.
'Yes, delicious, very delicious!' Savoring another spoonful, the second guest repeats how delicious it is.
'The head chef of this restaurant is a true master.' The host praises Claude Monet's head chef as a true master of his craft.
'We will definitely order another portion.' Enjoying the disguised pike roe so much, they decide to order another helping.

'Pass on our sincere gratitude to the chef.' The host asks the waiter to pass their warm compliments along to the chef. Now listen to the full conversation once more. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
Да, я такую только в Астрахани ел.
В Москве редко встретишь такое качество.
Я готов приходить сюда каждый день.

In the restaurant dining room, wealthy guests taste the disguised black caviar and rave about its natural Astrakhan quality, praising the chef for the magnificent appetizer. Next time you watch the episode, listen for the Russian expressions for 'to be felt' and 'rarely' — you will catch every word right away. See you next time!
